correctness.rationale: On P^5_C, the specific rank-nine globally generated E fits 0→E→O(1)^14→Omega^1(3)→0 and O^14→E. The Euler-sequence quotient computes c(E)=(1,5,13,21,21,21) and Segre c(E^vee)^(-1)=(1,5,12,16,8,0) through degree five. For quotient projectivization X=P(E), pushforward gives xi^13=0 and xi^12 H=8; basepoint freeness therefore makes f(X) a 12-dimensional integral hypersurface. Canonical bundle K_X=-9xi-H is antiample. Over a smooth generic fiber of f, every connected component C has xi.C=0,H.C>0 and 2g(C)-2=K_X.C=-H.C: hence g=0,H.C=2, and degree(W)*component_count=4. The rank≤4 degeneracy locus of a general 5-dimensional generating subspace has expected codimension five and Porteous class c5(E)=21; Kleiman transversality over C and avoidance of rank≤3 imply exactly 21 reduced points. Does NOT prove degree(W), fiber connectedness, normality, special fibers or embedded smooth base conics. Independently recalculated the two truncated series, canonical coefficients, and relevant integers; this does not replace generic-smoothness/Kleiman arguments.
